$comment: The challenge's content, Adam's to change: the effects a slice carries, the summons they bring, and the kinds of challenge progressions are drawn from. A first draft, planned with Adam on 2026-10-20, every name and number in it to be tuned. Not in the game yet: the simulator on /admin/inspect-challenges runs the server's engine on what is here, and shows and edits it; the game server takes on a change while it runs. The numbers that belong to no one entry are the balance's. See docs/plans/challenges.md and decision record 0107.

effects.$comment: Each aspect's effects by their ids, four or five to an aspect, of which a slice of that aspect carries two. Every slice meets every happening: a trigger fires as it meets one, and a passive works from second to second. One that needs match does so only while the latest happening has its slice's aspect; one that needs anti only while it has its anti-aspect, which is how a slice is made to meet its anti-aspect's happenings, unboosted; one that needs neither, in every happening. An effect's words name its numbers in braces, which the page fills in; one that summons names the summon, whose own numbers are below; one with a slot fits a keyFigure, lending one of their stats, or a structure, and one whose slot is onTheLine puts what is in it into the challenge as a summon, once; one that puts a buff or a debuff on names it, its seconds among its numbers. The aspect boost is the buff empowered, which a happening puts on whatever matches it until it ends; it grows what an effect does, and never a chance or a cost. The names are a first draft for Adam to change.

sellswords.name: Sellswords
sellswords.words: Hires a Mercenary, who pulls for this side every second.

noQuarter.name: No Quarter
noQuarter.words: Each Mercenary act: {chance}% chance to also kill an enemy summon it can beat.

saberRattling.name: Saber-Rattling
saberRattling.words: In a Diplomacy happening, the sabres rattle: every enemy slice is weakened for {seconds} s, and +{amount}.

warDrums.name: War Drums
warDrums.words: Beats the war drums: every summon of this side is hastened for {seconds} s.

envoy.name: Trusted Envoy
envoy.words: Adds the envoy's kindness to the tug.

sweeterTerms.name: Sweeter Terms
sweeterTerms.words: Turns each enemy summon: {strong}% if power beats its integrity, else {weak}%. No room: it deserts.

parley.name: Endless Parley
parley.words: +{perSecond} a second; while the opponent leads, their power is {power} lower.

ceasefire.name: Ceasefire
ceasefire.words: In a Violence happening, a ceasefire is brokered: every enemy summon is stunned for {seconds} s.

rebuke.name: Divine Rebuke
rebuke.words: An enemy summon acts: {chance}% chance every enemy slice loses {integrity} integrity.

ordination.name: Ordination
ordination.words: Ordains a Priest, who pulls by how far this side's integrity beats the enemy's.

sanctuary.name: Sanctuary
sanctuary.words: Puts the building on the line the first time it works; +{piety} piety if won.

miracle.name: Miracle
miracle.words: In a Reason happening, a miracle defies it: +{amount}, and every slice of this side is empowered for {seconds} s.

counsel.name: Learned Counsel
counsel.words: Adds the counsellor's reason to the tug.

refutation.name: Refutation
refutation.words: {chance}% chance to cancel each enemy trigger.

seenThrough.name: Seen Through
seenThrough.words: An enemy summon acts: {chance}% chance its tricks are seen through, and it is weakened for {seconds} s.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.words: Foresees the enemy's moves: every slice and summon of this side is warded for {seconds} s.

doubt.name: Sow Doubt
doubt.words: In a Holy happening, doubt is sown: every enemy summon is weakened for {seconds} s, and +{amount}.

watch.name: Raise the Watch
watch.words: Raises an Enforcer: costs this side, stuns the enemy's hardest-pulling summon.

curfew.name: Curfew
curfew.words: Rings the curfew bell: every enemy summon is aspect-bound for {seconds} s.

firmHand.name: The Firm Hand
firmHand.words: Lays down the law: every enemy slice is penalised for {seconds} s.

fealty.name: Oaths of Fealty
fealty.words: Every summon of this side swears fealty, and is steadfast for {seconds} s.

martialLaw.name: Martial Law
martialLaw.words: In a Freedom happening, martial law is declared: every enemy summon is stunned for {seconds} s, and +{amount}.

commons.name: Raise the Commons
commons.words: Raises a Rebel, who pulls harder while this side is behind.

defiance.name: Defiance
defiance.words: In an Authority happening, the people defy it: +{amount}, and every summon of this side is hastened for {seconds} s.

ownWill.name: Will of One's Own
ownWill.words: Once a challenge, this slice's aspect goes on matching through a happening that does not have it.

wordSpreads.name: The Word Spreads
wordSpreads.words: The word spreads: every slice of this side is echoing for {seconds} s.

countingHouse.name: Counting House
countingHouse.words: Puts the building on the line; +{wealth} wealth if won.

farmTaxes.name: Farm the Taxes
farmTaxes.words: Hires a Collector: costs this side, fills a coffer that pours at the next happening or the end.

pickBones.name: Pick the Bones
pickBones.words: +{amount} whenever an enemy summon is killed.

profiteering.name: Profiteering
profiteering.words: In a Generosity happening, there is profit in charity: +{amount} for each summon on the field, either side's.

patron.name: Open-Handed Patron
patron.words: Adds the patron's kindness to the tug.

alms.name: Give Alms
alms.words: Sends out a Benefactor, who pulls harder while this side is behind.

forgiveness.name: Debt Forgiveness
forgiveness.words: In a Greed happening, debts are forgiven: every coffer the enemy's summons hold pours this side's way.

tend.name: Tend the Wounded
tend.words: Binds the wounded and lifts their burdens: every debuff on this side is cleansed.

wildHunt.name: The Wild Hunt
wildHunt.words: Looses a Predator, who pulls, or now and then kills an enemy summon it can beat.

teeming.name: Teeming Wilds
teeming.words: An enemy summon acts: {chance}% chance a Creature comes to this side.

overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
overgrowth.words: In an Industry happening, the green creeps back: every enemy summon is eroding for {seconds} s.

dread.name: Dread of the Wilds
dread.words: The wilds close in on the enemy: every slice of theirs is weakened for {seconds} s.

engines.name: Raise the Engines
engines.words: Builds a Machine, which pulls for this side every second.

works.name: Works and Forges
works.words: Puts the building on the line.

wellOiled.name: Well-Oiled
wellOiled.words: A summon of this side acts: {chance}% chance it is hastened for {seconds} s.

clearLand.name: Clear the Land
clearLand.words: In a Nature happening, the land is cleared: every enemy summon is weakened for {seconds} s, and +{amount}.

summons.$comment: Each summon by its id: what it is called, its aspect, which its boost is judged by, and its numbers, which its words name. A summon acts once a second from the second after it arrives, until it is killed, turned or the challenge ends; its integrity is its slice's at the moment it was summoned. A building or a person put on the line is a summon too, made by the balance's rule rather than listed here. A summon that needs match acts only while the happening has its own aspect, one that needs anti only while it has its anti-aspect.

priest.name: Priest
priest.words: Pulls its side's integrity lead over the enemy's, times {share}.

enforcer.name: Enforcer
enforcer.words: Costs its side {costs} a second; stuns the hardest-pulling enemy summon {stuns} seconds.

rebel.name: Rebel
rebel.words: Pulls {pulls} a second, {behind} while its side is behind.

collector.name: Collector
collector.words: Costs its side {costs} a second, puts {deposits} in its coffer; the coffer is lost if it dies.

benefactor.name: Benefactor
benefactor.words: Pulls {pulls} a second, {behind} while its side is behind.

predator.name: Predator
predator.words: Pulls {pulls} a second, or {kills}% chance to kill an enemy summon it can beat instead.

buffs.$comment: Buffs, which help, by their ids: what each goes on, a slice or a summon, its words and its own numbers. An effect or a summon that puts one on names it, and says for how many seconds; put on again, it lasts from then and never stacks, and different ones add up. What each does is code, by its id. Empowered is the aspect boost too, which every happening puts on whatever matches it, until it ends.

hastened.name: Hastened
hastened.words: Acts again in {rate}% of its seconds.

echoing.name: Echoing
echoing.words: Each trigger: {chance}% chance it fires twice.

warded.name: Warded
warded.words: No debuff can be put on it.

debuffs.$comment: Debuffs, which hinder, by their ids: what each goes on, a slice or a summon, its words and its own numbers. An effect or a summon that puts one on names it, and says for how many seconds; put on again, it lasts from then and never stacks, and different ones add up. What each does is code, by its id.

aspectBound.name: Aspect-bound
aspectBound.words: Acts only while the happening has its own aspect.

eroding.name: Eroding
eroding.words: Each act costs it {integrity} integrity; at nothing it is gone.

penalised.name: Penalised
penalised.words: Each trigger it fires on a happening its aspect does not match costs its side {amount}.

kinds.$comment: Each challenge kind by its id: the seconds a challenge of it lasts and the happenings it has, each the least and the most, the chance out of a hundred that a happening has a second aspect, and how much each aspect weighs when a happening's aspects are drawn. A kind never has more happenings than the fewest seconds it lasts, so each begins on a second of its own.

debate.name: Debate
debate.words: Scholars arguing a point before an audience.

tradeWar.name: Trade war
tradeWar.words: Merchants and their princes fighting over a market.

sermon.name: Sermon
sermon.words: A preacher winning a crowd, or losing it.

even.name: Even
even.words: Every aspect alike: the ground the simulator weighs aspects against each other on.
